message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration serves as the cover for "TEMPO" magazine, dated "4-10 MARET 2024." The large red title "TEMPO" dominates the top, above the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Two stylized male figures in white collared shirts, green safety vests, and hardhats sit inside a yellow construction vehicle's cabin. The man on the left wears a white hardhat and smiles with closed eyes, his hands gripping a black control lever. The man on the right wears a lime green hardhat and holds another lever, looking forward with a neutral expression.

The cabin features a yellow metallic frame and large windows. Below them, white text reads "TENTAKEL NIKEL MENTERI BAHLIL" and "INVESTIGASI." Small white paragraphs appear at the bottom right. Headlines at the top include "Biang Kenaikan Harga Beras H.84" and "Proyek Karbon Jadi Sawit H.94." A barcode and QR code are located in the top right corner. The illustration uses smooth digital painting techniques with warm, directional lighting from the left.
